projects.title: Compact Residential Floor Plan
projects.subtitle: Internship · Houzz Pro
projects.summary: A compact single-level residence organized around a central great room and dining spine, with living, kitchen, and bath zones branching off a gabled core. The plan totals roughly 440 ft² — demonstrating spatial planning, dimensional accuracy, and the full design process from measured blueprint to furnished plan and interior visualization.
highlights: Programmed five distinct zones with area takeoffs on the construction blueprint (living ~148 ft², great room ~188 ft², kitchen ~70 ft², bath ~31 ft²).
Solved a recurring Houzz roof conflict by modeling rooms separately and assembling the plan step-by-step — persistence over restart.
Presented work at three scales: annotated 2D blueprint, furnished top-view plan, and interior perspective with lighting and material study.
